svg.text: An agent is an LLM in a loop: it reasons, uses tools and memory, acts on an environment,

text.style: font-family:'PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px

svg.text: and reads the result. Building one is easy. Making it reliable, safe, and measurable is the

text.style: font-family:'PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px
font-family:'PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px

svg.text: 智能体就是在循环中运行的 LLM：推理、使用工具和记忆、作用于环境、读取结果。造一个不难，难

text.style: font-family:'PingFang SC','Noto Sans CJK SC','Microsoft YaHei','Helvetica Neue',Arial,sans-serif;font-size:13px

svg.text: 的是让它可靠、安全、可衡量。
